landingPage.heroTitle: Studio Admin: Next.js admin dashboard template
landingPage.heroDescription: An open-source Next.js and shadcn/ui admin dashboard with a dozen dashboards, app screens and data tables, deployed on Hostinger at a reviewed version.
landingPage.about: Studio Admin is a free, open-source admin dashboard built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. It gives a SaaS back office, internal tool or client portal a modern layout from day one. About a dozen dashboards cover CRM, finance, analytics, e-commerce, logistics and more, each with charts and KPI cards. Mail, chat, calendar, kanban and invoice screens show common app patterns, and user, role and product tables come with search, filters, sorting and pagination. Theme presets, light and dark mode and layout settings let you match your brand. The data is sample data, so you connect your own backend. Hostinger deploys the original project at a version we have checked, with its MIT license.
